newsitem.title: USA: Vans sees Q1 revs up more than 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vans sees Q1 revs up more than 50 pct.

text.p: Vans Inc said Monday it expected revenues for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 to be more than 50 percent higher than the $28.4 million reported for the period last year.
The company also said it expects per share earnings for the quarter to be up more than 50 percent from the fiscal fourth quarter, when it earned $0.14 before charges.

"We are receiving very positive feedback from our national accounts regarding sell-through of product during this key back-to-school season, and we are noticing a marked resurgence in our independent account base which should bode well for the future," it said.

"Consumer acceptance of the VANS brand in the international arena continues to expand, and comparable-store sales in our retail operation currently are even stronger than the 7.4 percent gain posted in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996," it said.
The company said it had leased its Orange, Calif., facility and planned to move its offices and distribution center next spring to a new 180,000-square-foot facility in Santa Fe Springs.
